title: Cleaning Checklist Items Completed Leaderboard
dataSources: Roborock sessions (`roborock:session`), Tidy schedules (`tidy:schedule`), cleaning checklists (`cleaning:checklist`), and vacuum runtime logs (`vacuum:runtime`).
app: Roborock vacuum session exports, Tidy scheduling logs, cleaning checklists, and runtime telemetry from robot vacuums ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cleaning:checklist items_completed=*
| stats sum(items_completed) as total_value, avg(items_completed) as avg_value by checklist_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks checklist values by total and average items completed across cleaning checklist events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `items_completed` values for each cleaning checklist event and review total and average items completed by checklist.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total items completed.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which checklist shows the biggest items completed numbers in your cleaning checklist data.
